messages:
Noah R.: FYI I'm cleaning up an onboarding sample and hit a cascade of mypy/pyright errors. The autogenerated models from python-sdk mark a lot of fields as Any, and stream chunks are untyped dicts. Small repro: 
```py
resp = await client.chat.create(prompt="hey")
# mypy: "Item has type Any" when doing resp.output[0].text

async for chunk in client.chat.stream(prompt="hi"):
    # pyright: Property 'text' does not exist on type 'dict'
    print(chunk["text"])
```

Ivy (sdk): Thanks Noah. We've intentionally kept runtime shapes permissive for perf, but obviously typings are poor. Two quick asks: typed params (temperature: float, max_tokens: int | None) and a minimal TypedChunk for streamed events.

Omar B.: Agreed. Our internal libs vendored SDK stubs only to satisfy CI. If the generator produced .pyi stubs, teams could typecheck without changing runtime perf.

Ivy (sdk): Options on the table:
- Emit shallow TypedDict for stream with known keys (text: str | None, role: str | None, finished: bool | None).
- Add generic Response[T] and change return types for non-streaming ops to Response[Model].
- Generate .pyi stubs for the public surface so strict checkers see good signatures but runtime stays lean.
- Add client flags: typed_responses: bool = True (opt-out -> raw dicts) and return_raw_stream: bool = False.

Noah R.: +1 to opt-out flags. Some demo apps care more about raw perf than typing. If we default to typed_responses=True we might break a minority, so docs and a migration note are important.

Kai (devex): Please add two examples to examples/: typed_chat.py and typed_stream.py that are clean under mypy/pyright. Also a short note in the SDK README about minimum pydantic versions and how to opt-out. New hires rely on those examples. :point_up:

Ivy (sdk): Will do. Also plan: generator maps oneOf -> Union[...] (when safe), nullable -> Optional[...], and primitives to int/float/bool/str. We'll avoid heavy pydantic parsing in stream hot path (shallow wrapping only).

Omar B.: For .pyi stubs: make sure we include overloads for sync vs async variants. Some teams mix both. Also document how to vendor stubs only in CI to speed up checks.

types-bot: Created ticket SDK-TYP-394: "python-sdk: generate .pyi stubs, Response[T], TypedChunk; add typed_responses opt-out & examples" assigned to @ivy_sdk

Noah R.: Small nit: ensure streaming iterator type is AsyncIterator[TypedChunk] not AsyncIterator[Any]. That fixes most pyright noise.

Ivy (sdk): Good call. We'll also add a lightweight CI job that runs the examples under pyright with a recommended config. Targeting 0.10.0-alpha for full rollout and a 0.9.x patch for param typing fixes.

Kai (devex): Thanks team. Ping devex on the PR so we can update onboarding checklist and sample-app templates.

Ivy (sdk): Will do. I'll start a draft PR that includes generator template diffs, a .pyi generator, examples, and docs. Expect a follow-up in a few days.
